title: The 2000s in Order-World Events
blurb: Put these major world events in chronological order by year (2000–2009). The year is revealed at the end.

items.label: September 11 terrorist attacks in the United States
Barack Obama elected President of the United States
Indian Ocean tsunami devastates countries across Asia
Global financial crisis begins after collapse of Lehman Brothers
Euro becomes official currency in much of Europe
China hosts the Beijing Summer Olympics
